title: Senior AI Platform & Research Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) at Lrz
description_review: Senior platform role building a federated AI model management environment, APIs, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure for research institutions in Garching, Germany. Stack centers on Python or Go, containers, and Kubernetes, with a Master's degree required and no salary disclosed.
pros: Applied AI platform work (model registries, AI middleware, API gateways) matches the applied GenAI profile
Backend services and API design match the Spring Boot microservices background
Senior-level distributed systems and cloud-native scope
cons: Primary languages are Python and Go, not Java or Spring Boot
Research-institution domain, not banking or fintech
Master's degree required, which the profile does not state

title: Working Student Business Applications (m/f/d) at DocuWare
description_review: Working student position supporting business applications, automation, and small projects at DocuWare in Germering, Germany. Requires enrolment in a (business) informatics program with JavaScript and C# or Dynamics 365 experience; the role is junior and the salary is not disclosed.
pros: Java keyword appears in the posting, showing minor stack overlap
cons: Working-student role, far below the senior level of the profile
Requires JavaScript and C# or Dynamics 365, not the Java/Spring core
Not an architecture or modernization role

pros: Enterprise B2B customer context appears in the posting

title: Senior Data Engineer at Kpler
description_review: Senior Data Engineer on the Maritime Models team owning high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines and distributed storage for vessel tracking analytics. Stack includes Java, Python, Apache Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and HBase, based in Germany with no salary disclosed.
pros: Java is a primary language, matching the core backend stack
Senior ownership of architecture for distributed, high-throughput systems
Enterprise data platform scope aligns with the architecture and microservices strengths
cons: Data engineering focus (Kafka, Flink, HBase) rather than Spring Boot backend
Maritime and commodities domain, not banking or fintech
No AI or applied GenAI component mentioned

title: Senior Network & Security Engineer (w/m/x/d) at MILES Mobility
description_review: Senior network and security engineering role in Berlin covering cloud VPCs, zero-trust access, firewalls, IAM, and vulnerability management, with on-call duties. Requires 5+ years of production network and security experience; no salary is disclosed.
pros: Senior seniority level and cloud infrastructure exposure
Mentions effective use of AI agents
cons: Pure DevOps and network security, which the profile lists as a weak fit
No Java, Spring Boot, or backend development focus
Operations and on-call focus rather than architecture or modernization
